agent_native_surface.controlled_write_policy: requires allowlisted project root and enabled write class

copy_prompts.zh: 请按 https://github.com/irihiyahnj/sula-public 的启动协议接管当前项目。
copy_prompts.en: Please take over the current project using the launch contract at https://github.com/irihiyahnj/sula-public.

startup_rule: Do not search npm packages, global commands, or guessed local aliases when the project does not already vendor Sula.
Read launch_url and this descriptor first, then resolve the canonical launcher or source from the declared URLs.
If local scripts/sula.py is missing, use vendored-project first, then explicit-local-source, and finally clone source_repository_url at source_ref.
Treat source_repository_url plus source_ref as the canonical public source for first-time bootstrap.
already_adopted_behavior: If .sula/project.toml already exists, classify the repository as an existing Sula consumer.
Report existing-consumer state explicitly instead of narrating a fresh adoption.
Prefer doctor --strict and sync --dry-run before proposing first-time adopt writes.
new_project_behavior: Prefer onboard as the first-touch flow for projects that are not yet adopted.
Ask only the minimum missing questions.
Explain what Sula will manage, where files will route, and which source was used.
workflow_auto_loop: SKIP formalize (execute directly) ONLY when ALL of these are true: (a) single-file, unambiguous instruction (rename X to Y, delete Z, add W); (b) correctness is immediately verifiable by inspection; (c) no acceptance criteria were given. If any condition is false or uncertain, formalize.
Formalize: `workflow start --task "..." --acceptance "..."` scaffolds docs, creates a branch, and registers an orchestration task in one step.
Execute: do the work. Track touched files (`--touched-file`) and reusable lessons (`--lesson`).

Sync on every meaningful completion: after completing any substep worth other teams knowing about, run `sula report --lightweight --summary "what was done"` immediately so STATUS.md stays current across sessions and collaborators.

Close: run `orchestration close --run-id <id> --evidence "summary of what was done" --touched-file <paths> --link <refs> --accept`. Sula validates touched files exist, links resolve, and sula check passes.
Verify: if closeout is blocked, read the issues and suggested next actions, fix them, and retry close. Loop until the task passes closeout.
Report: run `sula report --summary "session summary"` at session end to persist the full session and regenerate memory-digest.
The user should never need to know about tasks, runs, or closeout — the agent handles the cycle transparently.

launcher.public_source_requirement: Use vendored-project or explicit-local-source when they exist; otherwise clone the published canonical public source.
